final: SELECT m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) as media_type_avg, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) - (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(t2.Bytes AS REAL) / t2.Milliseconds) as avg_bpm FROM Track t2 JOIN MediaType m2 ON t2.MediaTypeId = m2.MediaTypeId WHERE t2.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY t2.MediaTypeId)) as above_overall FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name HAVING media_type_avg > (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(t3.Bytes AS REAL) / t3.Milliseconds) as avg_bpm FROM Track t3 JOIN MediaType m3 ON t3.MediaTypeId = m3.MediaTypeId WHERE t3.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY t3.MediaTypeId)) ORDER BY m.Name
